images.title: A flower block stamped twice with a half turn
images.purpose: Show the worked example: a flower block stamped once at the top and once at the bottom after a 1/2 turn, so the print looks the same after a 1/2 turn.
images.composition: One print area with the first flower above the middle and the second flower below it, turned, and a curved arrow at the side for the 1/2 turn.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. One square print area, 420 by 420 px, centred in the frame (x 518 to 938, y 190 to 610), with a thin dark #2B2B2B outline and a white fill. In it exactly 2 identical flowers. Each flower is a round bloom 100 px across, teal #0072B2, on a straight stem 70 px long drawn as a thin dark line, with one small leaf 40 px long beside the stem. FLOWER 1 (Stamp 1): its stem starts at the centre of the print area (728, 400) and goes straight up to y 330, the bloom is at the top of the stem (centre 728, 280), and the leaf is on the right of the stem. FLOWER 2 (Stamp 2): the same flower turned a half turn: its stem starts at the centre (728, 400) and goes straight down to y 470, the bloom is at the bottom of the stem (centre 728, 520), upside down, and the leaf is on the left of the stem. The bloom of flower 2 is amber #E69F00 so it can be told from flower 1. To the right of the print area, one curved arrow in reddish purple #CC79A7 (8 px thick) running from the top flower down to the bottom flower and going half way round, at x 980 to 1080, y 270 to 530, with the text 1/2 turn (40 px, dark #1F2937) at x 1100, y 400. Beside the top bloom, to its left and centred at x 600, y 280, the label Stamp 1; beside the bottom bloom, to its right and centred at x 860, y 520, the label Stamp 2 (36 px, dark #1F2937). Exactly 2 flowers, 1 arrow and 3 labels. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Two stamps with a 1/2 turn between them make a print that looks the same after a 1/2 turn.
images.description: A square print area with a flower at the top and the same flower turned a half turn at the bottom, with a curved arrow marked 1/2 turn.
images.context: Concept image for the second teaching concept, One Block Printed Many Times. It uses the plan's own flower block (a practice value), not the book's leaf block.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student what the print looks like after a 1/2 turn: the top flower lands where the bottom one is. The slip to watch: thinking a 1/4 turn would also match.

image_decisions.why: The two stamps with the half turn between them make the worked example visible: 2 stamps match after a half turn only.
